text:
Maya (Product): quick sync — mosaic customer asked for a staggered pilot: tenant isolation, BYOK, and SLA p99 < 320ms. need dependency map and who owns the long lead.
Jon (PM): timeline request: pilot in 5w. acceptance: p99 <320ms, successful BYOK rotate, staged canary with 3 tenants.
Ravi (Runtime): runtime needs: prewarm signal API, tenant-scoped KV namespaces, and a fallback path to hosted models. prewarm requires infra to allocate reserved GPUs a few minutes prior.
Hannah (Infra): infra work: VPC peering for customer VPC, reserved GPU quota, and firewall rules for KMS endpoints. quota bump could be 7-10bd depending on cloud ops. peering + routing ~3bd post-security signoff.
Liu (Security): BYOK is the gating item. need vendor attestation, rotation policy, and key retention rules. estimate 8 business days for review once packet arrives. also require IAM matrix.
Zoe (Eng): eng scope: feature flag for tenant isolation, end-to-end tests, and a small console toggle for canary percentages. dev estimate ~2.5w. can start mocks now.
Amit (SRE): SRE needs tenant SLOs, synthetic cold-start probe every 6h, and an automated rollback policy: route a tenant to hosted fallback on sustained p99 violation. I'll draft runbook.
Maya (Product): so critical path is security packet -> quota approvals -> runtime integration. can we parallelize work to hit 5w?
Liu (Security): reviews can start in parallel with spikes, but we cannot approve peering or KMS credentials until vendor attestation is validated.
Ravi (Runtime): i'll spike a prewarm shim with a health endpoint this week: ```GET /tenant/{id}/warm -> {"warm":true|false, "kv_prefetch":"done|pending"}``` routing can use this for smarter fallbacks.
Zoe (Eng): will wire the feature flag to the mocked endpoint and add unit/integration tests. posting RFC by EOW.
Hannah (Infra): i'll open quota and peering tickets now and tag cloud-ops. need customer CIDRs and expected peak GPU count.
Jon (PM): Mosaic to provide CIDRs and KMS vendor by tomorrow. asked them to upload vendor attestation.
Amit (SRE): proposed rollback policy: if tenant p99 >320ms for 10m, shift to hosted fallback for 30m, notify oncall, and create incident if persisting. ok?
Ravi (Runtime): ok. will add routing toggle and health check influence so only warm tenants stay on private path.
Liu (Security): callout: if vendor attestation lacks SOC2 or equivalent, review may add 2+ weeks. suggest contingency: temporary hosted BYOK shim.
Maya (Product): agreed. contingency: hosted BYOK shim if attestation delayed. list as acceptance alternative.
Hannah (Infra): ticket opened: INFRA-MOSAIC-491. linking this thread. quota request submitted.
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-MOSAIC-491 created by Hannah.
Zoe (Eng): RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/tenant-isolation-mosaic-mvp (contains tests + rollout steps).
Ravi (Runtime): updated the spike doc with KV eviction and prefix cache notes. added edge-case for cold misses.
Jon (PM): action items recap: 1) Liu: start BYOK attestation review (8bd). 2) Hannah: quota + peering tickets (3bd). 3) Ravi/Zoe: prewarm shim + feature flags + RFC (EOW). 4) Amit: runbook + rollback policy draft (2bd). 5) Maya/Jon: confirm acceptance criteria with Mosaic (2bd). please ack with :white_check_mark:.
Liu (Security): acked :white_check_mark:. started review.
Hannah (Infra): acked :white_check_mark:. pinging cloud-ops for quota.
Zoe (Eng): acked :white_check_mark:. will post tests link.
Amit (SRE): acked :white_check_mark:. drafting runbook now.
Maya (Product): thanks. next sync Wed 10am to check attestation + quota. escalate if attestation stalls. react :thumbsup: when seen.
